# v1.4.0

- New skill `credits-rules`: for coding agents that add AI credits, usage limits, credit packs or top-ups. What App Review, Google Play and EU consumer rules require on the screen (packs that never expire unless the app joins Apple's expiring-credits program for generative AI, and what that program asks for), and the states agents tend to leave silent: failed runs, store refunds, pending purchases, restore, limits with a local reset time. Rules dated November 8, 2026.
